newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - May 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - May 13.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- President Jiang Zemin meets Japan Trade Unions Confederation President Ashita Jinnosuke, urges cooperation
- Premier Li Peng arrives in Tanzania
- Editorial hails outstanding disabled and urges people to learn from their courage
- Dongfanghong-3 communications satellite successfully launched
- April retail price inflation at year-on-year 1.1 percent, RPI for first four months at 2.3 percent
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- People's Liberation Army, People's Armed Police begin patriotic study campaign
FINANCIAL NEWS
- China financial development steady in first quarter, with M2 up 21.1 percent, M1 up 18.4 percent, M0 up 13.6 percent
- Qinghai province Lijiaxia Hydropower plant and Qinghai Qiaotou power plant project issue 40 million yuan worth of two-year bonds at annual interest rate of 10.2 percent
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- Editorial hails shareholding system as new innovation for state-owned enterprise
CHINA DAILY
- Inspection by National People's Congress to improve rights for women
- Education to help to keep population within 1.3 billion by 2000
- Fire police watch for danger in forests
- Largest power industry joint venture in northwest, Weihe Power Co, turns on power in Shaanxi province
- Microsoft unveils Chinese version of Office 97
- Standard Chartered offers $5.0 million working capital loan to China Golden Valley International Trust and Investment Corp
